title.value: Resolution directing staff to meet and confer with labor unions on declaring Cesar Chavez Day a City of Fresno holiday

citations.quote: RESOLUTION - Directing staff to perform the necessary meet and confer with labor unions related to declaring Cesar Chavez Day a holiday in the City of Fresno (Subject to Mayor’s Veto).
